info.name: Electricity Maps Carbon Intensity Power Breakdown API

params.name: zone
params.description: Zone identifier (e.g. DE, FR, GB, US-CAL-CISO). Alternative to lat/lon.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of the location to resolve to a zone. Used with lon as an alternative to zone.

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude of the location to resolve to a zone. Used with lat as an alternative to zone.

items.docs: Retrieves the last known power consumption and production breakdown of a zone, representing the physical origin of electricity broken down by production type, with import/export flows. Queryable by zone or geolocation.

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude of the location to resolve to a zone. Used with lat as an alternative to zone.

items.docs: Retrieves the last 24 hours of power consumption and production breakdown of a zone, with a resolution of 60 minutes.

items.docs: Retrieves the forecasted power production breakdown of a zone, up to 24-72 hours ahead depending on plan.
